title: SUNAR: Semantic Uncertainty based Neighborhood Aware Retrieval for Complex QA
authors: V Venktesh; Mandeep Rathee; Avishek Anand
why_relevant: Uses semantic uncertainty from LLM answer candidates as feedback to guide retrieval, addressing bounded-recall in complex QA. Touches on uncertainty-aware retrieval which is tangential to robust RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on improving recall for multi-hop QA, not specifically on robustness to noise, conflict, or adversarial evidence.
